reviewers: Two independent AI reviewers under the same instructions and inherited model/settings; no expert-certification claim
assignment: Within each work, sort SHA256(42|review|case_id), alternate a/b; all four outputs for a case go to the same reviewer
blindness: Opaque per-output review IDs; no condition, prompt, model name, ordering or runtime metadata in packets. Original source, references and pre-output constraints only.
ratings: For primary15 use unchanged PAL-REF meaning categories and accepted/meaning_error/critical_error/uncertain. Non-success execution stays separately visible. For constrained9 use constrained_only and supported-span findings/unknown-span treatment, never whole-translation acceptance.
comparison: Paired percase and perwork across fourconditions; no population accuracy or p-values; preserve all failures/unattempted outputs. Do not count legitimate readings or reference uncertainty as model errors.
